summary: Accounts / Finance sub_admin role (iteration 78) verified end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_accounts_finance_role.py — (a) master creates sub-admin with sales:view_all via POST /api/admin/sub-admins, magic_url returned, persistence verified via GET /api/admin/sub-admins; (b) full magic-link flow: GET /api/auth/magic/{token} 200 → POST /api/auth/magic/{token}/complete sets password, session cookies issued, /api/auth/me returns role=sub_admin with permissions:['sales:view_all']; (c) RBAC deny: finance user gets 403 on /api/admin/sub-admins and /api/admin/admins; (d) /api/admin/sales-report as finance returns 200 all-sites data with new per_payment_status and per_payment_method arrays (2026-09: paid ₹210/1 + pending ₹120/1, grand ₹330/2); xlsx download works (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 5KB+); (e) limited-scope variant (sales:view + site_ids=[<site>]) creates successfully; (f) master's own /api/admin/sales-report also carries the new payment breakdown fields. Frontend: /master/admins → New Admin → role='accounts' selected: new-admin-password is disabled, accounts-all-sites is checked by default, submit-admin-btn creates the user, operator-invite-modal appears with a valid /auth/magic/… operator-invite-link, sub-admins-section shows the new card with chip 'View sales for ALL sites (company-wide finance)'. Magic-link completion (Finance#1234) redirects to /sub-admin/dashboard (testid sub-admin-dashboard) which shows ONLY the sub-admin-card-sales-view_all card and sub-admin-scope='All sites · company-wide (finance)'. Navbar shows nav-sales only — nav-cities/sites/vendors/clients/admins/onboarding/domains are all ABSENT for this finance user. On /reports/sales after Apply for Month=2026-09: sales-payment-breakdown, sales-pay-status-paid ('PAID ₹210.00 1 order'), sales-pay-status-pending ('PENDING ₹120.00 1 order'), sales-per-payment-table, sales-by-city/client/site/vendor, and sales-download-xlsx-btn are all rendered. RBAC deny confirmed in UI: visiting /master/admins, /master/dashboard, /master/sites all redirect to /sub-admin/dashboard and create-admin-btn is not present. No horizontal overflow at 1920px or 390px on either /reports/sales or /sub-admin/dashboard (0px both).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/sites.py has grown to 1594 lines and now hosts sub-admin CRUD, sub-admin activity, resend, magic-link email plumbing plus the actual sites routes; strong candidate for splitting into routers/admin_sub_admins.py to keep files under 700 lines (also noted in earlier iterations).

The 'accounts' role in Admins.js is purely a client-side preset that maps to sub_admin + permissions=['sales:view_all'|'sales:view'] — the server has no dedicated validation that rejects mixing sales:view_all with other high-privilege permissions. Not exploitable today (only master can call POST /api/admin/sub-admins and the UI restricts the perm set), but consider a server-side guard so that if 'sales:view_all' is present it must be the only permission, to lock in the 'accounts-only' contract.
